info.name: GitHub Get Job for Workflow Run

params.name: owner
params.description: The account owner of the repository. The name is not case sensitive.

params.name: repo
params.description: The name of the repository without the `.git` extension. The name is not case sensitive.

params.name: job_id
params.description: The unique identifier of the job.

items.docs:
Gets a specific job in a workflow run.

Anyone with read access to the repository can use this endpoint.

If the repository is private, OAuth tokens and personal access tokens (classic) need the `repo` scope to use this endpoint.

info.name: GitHub Download Job Logs for Workflow Run

params.name: owner
params.description: The account owner of the repository. The name is not case sensitive.

params.name: repo
params.description: The name of the repository without the `.git` extension. The name is not case sensitive.

params.name: job_id
params.description: The unique identifier of the job.

items.docs:
Gets a redirect URL to download a plain text file of logs for a workflow job. This link expires after 1 minute. Look
for `Location:` in the response header to find the URL for the download.

Anyone with read access to the repository can use this endpoint.

If the repository is private, OAuth tokens and personal access tokens (classic) need the `repo` scope to use this endpoint.

info.name: GitHub List Jobs for Workflow Run Attempt

params.name: owner
params.description: The account owner of the repository. The name is not case sensitive.

params.name: repo
params.description: The name of the repository without the `.git` extension. The name is not case sensitive.

params.name: run_id
params.description: The unique identifier of the workflow run.

params.name: attempt_number
params.description: The attempt number of the workflow run.

params.name: per_page
params.description: The number of results per page (max 100). For more information, see "[Using pagination in the REST API](https://docs.github.com/enterprise-server@3.9/rest/using-the-rest-api/using-pagination-in-the-rest-api)."

params.name: page
params.description: The page number of the results to fetch. For more information, see "[Using pagination in the REST API](https://docs.github.com/enterprise-server@3.9/rest/using-the-rest-api/using-pagination-in-the-rest-api)."

items.docs:
Lists jobs for a specific workflow run attempt. You can use parameters to narrow the list of results. For more information
about using parameters, see [Parameters](https://docs.github.com/enterprise-server@3.9/rest/guides/getting-started-with-the-rest-api#parameters).

Anyone with read access to the repository can use this endpoint.

OAuth app tokens and personal access tokens (classic) need the `repo` scope to use this endpoint  with a private repository.

info.name: GitHub List Jobs for Workflow Run

params.name: owner
params.description: The account owner of the repository. The name is not case sensitive.

params.name: repo
params.description: The name of the repository without the `.git` extension. The name is not case sensitive.

params.name: run_id
params.description: The unique identifier of the workflow run.

params.name: filter
params.description: Filters jobs by their `completed_at` timestamp. `latest` returns jobs from the most recent execution of the workflow run. `all` returns all jobs for workflow run, including from old executions of the workflow run.

params.name: per_page
params.description: The number of results per page (max 100). For more information, see "[Using pagination in the REST API](https://docs.github.com/enterprise-server@3.9/rest/using-the-rest-api/using-pagination-in-the-rest-api)."

params.name: page
params.description: The page number of the results to fetch. For more information, see "[Using pagination in the REST API](https://docs.github.com/enterprise-server@3.9/rest/using-the-rest-api/using-pagination-in-the-rest-api)."

items.docs:
Lists jobs for workflow run. You can use parameters to narrow the list of results. For more information
about using parameters, see [Parameters](https://docs.github.com/enterprise-server@3.9/rest/guides/getting-started-with-the-rest-api#parameters).

Anyone with read access to the repository can use this endpoint.

OAuth app tokens and personal access tokens (classic) need the `repo` scope to use this endpoint with private repository.

info.name: GitHub Re-run Failed Jobs from Workflow Run

params.name: owner
params.description: The account owner of the repository. The name is not case sensitive.

params.name: repo
params.description: The name of the repository without the `.git` extension. The name is not case sensitive.

params.name: run_id
params.description: The unique identifier of the workflow run.

items.docs:
Re-run all of the failed jobs and their dependent jobs in a workflow run using the `id` of the workflow run.

OAuth app tokens and personal access tokens (classic) need the `repo` scope to use this endpoint.
